title: 第914章 跨越时间本神子陪你走一趟第913章 陈归尘 我一定会回来的
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
这一刻。
陈归尘整个人仿佛化作了一个孤注一掷的赌徒。
他坚信自己掌握着改变命运的力量。
只要不断重启，总能够得到自己想要的结果。
炎璃公主看着眼前这一幕，眉头越皱越深。
她没有被这番话感动，反而感到了一丝莫名的寒意。
“这家伙…”
“到底想做什么？”
她明明现在很好。
是炎狱魔宫公主，有自己的道路。
可陈归尘的这番话，却仿佛已经替她决定好了未来，这让炎璃心中产生了一种强烈的不适。
姜夜此刻的双眸中，金色光芒缓缓流转。
刹那间。
一股无比玄妙的力量降临。
“光之溯源。”
轰！
虚空之中。
无数金色神纹骤然浮现。
一道道光芒，如同跨越岁月而来的丝线，瞬间缠绕向陈归尘。
他的身体猛然一震。

脸上的疯狂之色，第一次出现了变化。
“什么？”
陈归尘瞳孔骤缩。
他能够感觉到，自己体内的回档力量，疑似正在被某种恐怖存在窥视。
轰！
虚空之中。
无数金色神纹骤然浮现。
一道道光芒，如同跨越岁月而来的丝线，瞬间缠绕向陈归尘。
他的身体猛然一震。
脸上的疯狂之色，第一次出现了变化。
“什么？”
陈归尘瞳孔骤缩。
姜夜眸光微动。
看着陈归尘此刻的反应，心中已经有了几分猜测。
“轮回重启一类的能力么…”
他轻声自语。
刚才陈归尘那番近乎疯狂的话，已经透露出了太多信息。
一次次死亡。
一次次重新开始。
改变过去。

修正未来。
这根本不是普通意义上的秘法，而是一种凌驾于寻常修士认知上的规则力量。
content_en:
This moment.
Chen Guichen seemed to have turned into a desperate gambler.
He firmly believes that he has the power to change his destiny.
As long as you keep restarting, you can always get the results you want.
Princess Yanli frowned deeper and deeper as she looked at the scene in front of her.
She was not moved by these words, but felt an inexplicable chill.
"This guy..."
"What do you want to do?"
She is clearly fine now.
She is the princess of the Flame Hell Demon Palace and has her own path.
But Chen Guichen's words seemed to have decided the future for her, which made Yanli feel a strong discomfort in her heart.
Golden light slowly flowed in Jiang Ye's eyes at this moment.
In an instant.
An incomparable mysterious force came.
"The origin of light."
Boom!
In the void.
Countless golden divine patterns suddenly appeared.
Rays of light, like silk threads that spanned the years, instantly wrapped around Chen Guichen.
His body shook suddenly.
The crazy look on his face changed for the first time.
"What?"
Chen Guichen's pupils shrank suddenly.
He could feel that the reversal power in his body was being watched by some kind of terrifying existence.
boom!
In the void.
Countless golden divine patterns suddenly appeared.
Rays of light, like silk threads that spanned the years, instantly wrapped around Chen Guichen.
His body shook suddenly.
The crazy look on his face changed for the first time.
"What?"
Chen Guichen's pupils shrank suddenly.
Jiang Ye's eyes moved slightly.
Looking at Chen Guichen's reaction at this moment, I already had some guesses in my mind.
"Is it the ability to restart reincarnation..."
He whispered to himself.
Chen Guichen's almost crazy words just now revealed too much information.
Death after death.
Start again and again.
Change the past.
Fix the future.
This is not a secret method in the ordinary sense at all, but a power of rules that surpasses the cognition of ordinary monks.
